notes: No AI provider publishes per-request figures for Claude yet. These factors are triangulated from published third-party and provider methodology work, carry wide uncertainty bands (shown in UI), and will be revised continually with provider and open-source community data. Every revision bumps the version. Token counts for Claude Code are now EXACT (read from local session transcripts), so estimation error there collapses to the energy factors alone.

sources.note: Google Gemini serving methodology: median text prompt 0.24 Wh, 0.26 mL water, 0.03 gCO2e including datacenter overheads
Epoch AI estimate ~0.3 Wh per GPT-4o-class text query
OpenAI stated average 0.34 Wh per query
World average grid carbon intensity ~350 gCO2e/kWh; will become region-aware

Agentic clients (Claude Code etc.) re-send conversation context on every call but providers serve most of it from prompt cache at a fraction of full-reprocessing cost. Measured on a real Claude Code session: ~93% of input tokens were cache reads. Claude Code transcripts give the exact fresh/cache split per message, so freshInputFraction is no longer needed for that path.

Larger models use more energy per token, roughly with active parameter count, which Anthropic does not publish. modelTiers are provisional multipliers relative to a Sonnet-class baseline (1.0), to be replaced with measured figures from open inference-energy work (ML.ENERGY leaderboard, Hugging Face AI Energy Score).
